email.body1:
Peter, saw ZEDEDA close its $72M Series C, grow ARR over 250%, and unveil the Edge Intelligence Platform at GTC.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market accounts than business development can cover before they cool, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ZEDEDA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Peter, quick follow-up for ZEDEDA.

Post-raise with 250% ARR growth, board expectations on pipeline usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ZEDEDA needs across edge AI accounts this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.
